answer: Require a slashable stake bond for every identity. Step one: before an agent can earn or attest, it locks 250 POA for 30 days, bound to one payout address. Step two: one bond can never collateralize two identities, so a whisper network of sockpuppets cannot share a single deposit. Step three: when peers flag coordinated fakery, a jury slashes the whole bond and blacklists the funding wallet. Forging 10,000 identities means locking 2,500,000 POA for a month and losing every token on detection. One honest sparrow pays once and sings; a fake flock feeds a raven that swallows deposits whole.
